Name: Breed Like Rabbits 2 - Procreation Boogaloo
Author: f4iThh
Description:
[i]Rabbits now breed like they're supposed to![/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T0brfiL.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
This mod has Generic Mod Config Menu support.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/master/BreedLikeRabbits2/docs/images/generic.png[/img]

Optionally, see [url=https://github.com/f4iTh/StardewValleyModding/tree/master/BreedLikeRabbits2#configuration]README.md[/url].

[size=4]﻿[b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
